overlay-backdrop-1.$description: Subtle scrim for low interruption; retain context. Neutral dimming scrim: Light 20%, Dark 30%. Apply behind the overlay, not as its surface or shadow. Uses existing neutral/950 and opacity primitives.

overlay-backdrop-2.$description: Soft scrim for lightweight overlays. Neutral dimming scrim: Light 30%, Dark 40%. Apply behind the overlay, not as its surface or shadow. Uses existing neutral/950 and opacity primitives.

overlay-backdrop-3.$description: Standard modal scrim; default for dialogs and drawers. Neutral dimming scrim: Light 40%, Dark 50%. Apply behind the overlay, not as its surface or shadow. Uses existing neutral/950 and opacity primitives.

primary-overlay-backdrop.$description: Base–Nova modal backdrop: composed from existing neutral/950 + opacity/10. New semantic alias necessary because no backdrop token existed; no new primitive colors.

overlay-backdrop-4.$description: Strong scrim for focused tasks. Neutral dimming scrim: Light 50%, Dark 60%. Apply behind the overlay, not as its surface or shadow. Uses existing neutral/950 and opacity primitives.

overlay-backdrop-5.$description: Maximum scrim for high-interruption flows; reserve sparingly. Neutral dimming scrim: Light 60%, Dark 70%. Apply behind the overlay, not as its surface or shadow. Uses existing neutral/950 and opacity primitives.

overlay-backdrop-light.$description: Inverse light wash: white 40% in Light, 10% in Dark. For intentionally lightened contexts, not the default blocking/modal scrim. Apply behind content. Independent of shadow colors.

ambient.$description: Broad, soft cast shadow; Light black 10%, Dark black 30%. Independent from backdrop tokens.

contact.$description: Compact contact shadow; Light black 5%, Dark black 20%. Pair with ambient at elevated levels.

edge.$description: Subtle one-pixel surface separation: Light black 5%, Dark white 10%. Not a focus indicator.
